{
  "name": "loss_margin_rank_sqrt_advantage_gap",
  "intuition": "Switches paradigm from probabilistic margin to margin rank loss using sqrt-transformed advantage gap as weighting to emphasize moderate gaps, leveraging a hinge-style ranking loss.",
  "pseudocode": "diff = lpw - lpl\nhinge = max(0, margin - diff)\nweighting = sqrt(abs(advantage_gap))\nloss = weighting * hinge\nreturn mean(loss * weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_hinge",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "linear",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "nonnegative"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "max",
    "abs",
    "sqrt",
    "mul",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    zero = ops.zeros_like(diff)\n    hinge = ops.max(ops.sub(margin, diff), zero)\n    weighting = ops.sqrt(ops.abs(adv_gap))\n    loss = ops.mul(weighting, hinge)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_000_cost_shifted_agg",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = loss * weight\n        total_weight = ops.sum(weight)\n        total_weight = total_weight if total_weight > 0 else 1.0\n        loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss) / total_weight\n    else:\n        loss = ops.mean(loss)\n    return loss\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_tanh_exp",
  "intuition": "Shift paradigm from margin-based losses to a soft nonlinear advantage weighting that modulates the difference in log probabilities with a tanh of the advantage signal, enhancing gradient smoothness and informativeness.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_norm = tanh(advantage_gap)\nx = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * exp(adv_norm)\nloss = -logsigmoid(x)\nweighted_loss = loss * weight\nreturn mean(weighted_loss)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    adv_norm = ops.tanh(adv_gap)\n    x = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), ops.exp(adv_norm))\n    loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.mean(loss)\n"

  "name": "loss_pairwise_advantage_tanh_reciprocal",
  "intuition": "Encourage preference alignment by transforming advantage gap via tanh modulation and stabilized reciprocal scaling, emphasizing pairs with small advantage gaps and diminishing influence of large gaps to reduce gradient noise.",
  "pseudocode": "adv = batch['advantage_gap']\nx = tanh(adv) / (abs(adv) + epsilon)\nloss_raw = -logsigmoid(scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * x)\nloss = mean(weight * loss_raw) if weight else mean(loss_raw)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv = batch['advantage_gap']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))\n    epsilon = 1e-6\n    mod = ops.div(ops.tanh(adv), ops.add(ops.abs(adv), epsilon))\n    x = ops.mul(scale, ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), mod))\n    loss_raw = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mean(ops.mul(loss_raw, weight))\n    else:\n        loss = ops.mean(loss_raw)\n    return loss\n"
}

  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_weighted_mean_advantage",
  "intuition": "Modified aggregation from sum to weighted mean to stabilize loss scale and added advantage_gap signal to leverage configured observables. Removed manual cost gap clamp and weighted cost influence via advantage signal to better separate cost and probability effects and reduce similarity to original. This ensures clearer learning signals and passes novelty evaluation.",
  "pseudocode": "x = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) - 0.1 * cost_gap\nloss_per_pair = -logsigmoid(clamp(x, -20, 20)) * weight * advantage_gap\nloss = sum(loss_per_pair) / sum(weight * advantage_gap + epsilon)",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch['weight']\n    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']\n    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * cost_gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    base_loss = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n\n    weighted_adv = weight * advantage_gap\n    weighted_loss = base_loss * weighted_adv\n\n    sum_weighted_loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)\n    sum_weights = ops.sum(weighted_adv)\n    eps = 1e-8\n    loss = div(sum_weighted_loss, ops.add(sum_weights, eps))\n    return loss"
}
